name: Northwest Samsur Outpost
title: Northwest Samsur Outpost
summary: Old starter outpost north-west of Samsur, destroyed by Martine in The First Strike (acpedia). In the kit: a 28 m Empyrean tower with green lamps, an octagon tower, a cottage and the Life Stone on a flat sand-and-rock plain.

site.name: Northwest Samsur Outpost
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer life-stone-near-samsur-937f (the outpost Life Stone, 9 m from the anchor).

shots.standingOrder: Lock off 75 m south-east of the Northwest Samsur outpost with the green-lit Empyrean tower on the left third while the sky clock runs and clouds race over it; nothing within 25 m, chickens may be faded.
